items.evidence: Reservoir in slot 1 and plate in slot 2 are loaded with the required labels. The p20 (left) and p300 (right) pipettes use the specified tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
The run log shows 100 uL aspirated from reservoir A1 and dispensed into plate A1 (lines 2-3), then 100 uL into plate B1 (lines 6-7), all with the p300. No other wells were touched.
Each transfer is preceded by pick up tip and ended with drop tip (log lines 1, 4, 5, 8), so no tip is held at the end.
100 uL is within the p300 range, apiLevel 2.15 is allowed, and the blow_out is at the destination well top, which is safe.
The protocol does only the single requested transfer and nothing else. The metadata and the final comment accurately describe it.

judge.summary: The protocol loads the specified labware with the required labels and moves 100 uL from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and then to plate B1, using the p300 with a fresh tip each time. It simulates cleanly and every rubric item passes.
